journey.name: cached profile header
journey.description:
Opening Profile while the profile is still loading after a relaunch shows a read-only header built from the cached name, avatar and key, then the full profile once the load finishes. The header shows only while the load is in flight and only for the identity the cache was taken from. Edit, the QR code, Share and Tags wait for the loaded profile.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with Paykit enabled (the default), PIN off, and an active Pubky profile with a name and an avatar, created in Bitkit or adopted from Pubky Ring. The first steps open Profile once so the name, avatar and key are cached before the relaunch.
On a fast network the load can finish before Profile opens, so the journey slows the emulator network with adb emu; a physical device needs another way to slow its connection. If the full profile still shows at once, run adb emu network speed gsm and repeat from the relaunch. If the load fails instead, the cached header gives way to the retry state (testTag "ProfileRetry"), which is not what this journey covers: relax the throttle and repeat. If the session is still restoring when the profile button is tapped, the button opens the Pubky choice screen, which moves on to Profile by itself once the session is back. The avatar is an image with no text, so check it from a screenshot.

actions.action: Tap the profile button (testTag "ProfileButton") on the home screen
Verify the full profile shows its name (testTag "ProfileViewName") and note the name
Run adb emu network delay gprs and adb emu network speed edge
Run adb shell am force-stop to.bitkit.dev, then adb shell am start -n to.bitkit.dev/to.bitkit.ui.MainActivity
As soon as the home screen shows, tap the profile button (testTag "ProfileButton")
Verify the cached header (testTag "ProfileCachedHeader") is visible with the noted name (testTag "ProfileCachedName"), the truncated public key and a loading spinner
Take a screenshot and verify the header shows the profile's avatar, not the placeholder icon
Verify Edit (testTag "ProfileEdit"), the QR code (testTag "ProfileQRCode"), Share (testTag "ProfileShare") and the Tags header (testTag "ProfileViewTagsHeader") are not shown

Wait up to a minute for the load to finish, then verify the full profile has replaced the cached header: the cached header (testTag "ProfileCachedHeader") is gone and the same name (testTag "ProfileViewName"), Edit (testTag "ProfileEdit"), the QR code (testTag "ProfileQRCode") and Share (testTag "ProfileShare") are visible
Scroll down and verify the Tags header (testTag "ProfileViewTagsHeader") is visible
Run adb emu network delay none and adb emu network speed full
